---
title: "Immune composition and inflammatory milieu within 200 um of a nerve"
output: html_document
---

<!--
============================================================
immune_cells_0_200um.Rmd

Per-ROI immune composition and inflammatory milieu in the COMET immune
panel, restricted to the ROIs that lie within 200 um of a nerve -- the
window reported in the manuscript.

Upstream: processing_ROIs.R combines the per-ROI exports into one
per-cell table (rule-based classifications plus nuclear marker
intensities and dot counts). That file, after manual correction of the
rule-based labels, is the input here.

Each ROI contributes one value per measure:
  immune composition   % of immune cells in each population
  CD45+ fraction       % of all cells that are CD45+
  cytokine positivity  % of CD45+ cells with >= DOT_THRESHOLD nuclear
                       dots for IFNG, CXCL9 or IL1B
  PD-L1                % of CD45+ cells classified CD45+PDL1+

The four inflammatory markers therefore share one denominator (CD45+
cells) and can be read on the same axis.

No distance modelling is performed: distance is used only to select the
0-200 um window.

Inputs  : input/combined_selected_columns_corrected_manually.csv
          input/ROIs_immune_cells.csv   (columns ROI, Distance_nerve_um)
Outputs : output/immune_cells/per_ROI_values.csv
          output/immune_cells/summary_0-200um.csv
          output/immune_cells/Fig_immune_composition_0-200um.pdf
          output/immune_cells/Fig_inflammatory_milieu_0-200um.pdf
============================================================
-->

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r settings}
# ---- Paths ------------------------------------------------------------
CELL_FILE     <- file.path("input", "combined_selected_columns_corrected_manually.csv")
DISTANCE_FILE <- file.path("input", "ROIs_immune_cells.csv")
OUT_DIR       <- file.path("output", "immune_cells")

dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- Analysis settings ------------------------------------------------
# Window reported in the manuscript: ROIs whose centre lies within this
# distance of the nearest nerve.
MAX_DISTANCE_UM <- 200

# A cell counts as positive for a cytokine at this many nuclear dots or more.
DOT_THRESHOLD <- 5

# One ROI export carries no ROI number in its filename and is recorded as
# missing; it is ROI22. (Noted here rather than edited into the input file.)
ROI_WITHOUT_NUMBER <- "ROI22"

# "non immune cells" is the CD45- remainder, not an immune population.
# TRUE  -> composition is expressed as % of immune cells
# FALSE -> composition is expressed as % of all classified cells
EXCLUDE_NON_IMMUNE <- TRUE

# ---- Immune label harmonisation --------------------------------------
# The rule-based classifier writes its own labels; these are the names
# used in the figures and in the colour palette.
IMMUNE_RECODE <- c(
  "CD4 T cells"       = "Lymphocyte(CD4)",
  "CD8 T cells"       = "Lymphocyte(CD8)",
  "CD8- CD4- T cells" = "Lymphocytes(CD4-CD8-)",
  "NK cells"          = "Lymphocyte(NK)",
  "CD20+ cells"       = "B_cells",
  "CD11c DCs"         = "Myeloid(DCs)",
  "CD68+ macro"       = "Myeloid(Macrophages)",
  "Other immune cells" = "Other immune",
  "non immune cells"  = "Non_immune"
)

# ---- Colours (as in the other figures of the paper) -------------------
IMMUNE_COLOURS <- c(
  "Lymphocyte(CD4)"       = "green4",
  "Lymphocyte(CD8)"       = "palegreen2",
  "Lymphocytes(CD4-CD8-)" = "darkolivegreen",
  "Lymphocyte(NK)"        = "green2",
  "B_cells"               = "maroon",
  "Myeloid(DCs)"          = "orchid1",
  "Myeloid(Macrophages)"  = "#6A3D9A",
  "Other immune"          = "skyblue2",
  "Non_immune"            = "grey"
)

# ---- Inflammatory markers, in plotting order --------------------------
MARKERS <- c(IFNG_percent  = "IFNγ",
             CXCL9_percent = "CXCL9",
             PDL1_percent  = "PD-L1",
             IL1B_percent  = "IL1B")
```

## 1. Read the per-cell table and harmonise labels

```{r read}
if (!file.exists(CELL_FILE))     stop("Per-cell table not found: ", CELL_FILE,
                                      " -- run processing_ROIs.R first.")
if (!file.exists(DISTANCE_FILE)) stop("ROI distance table not found: ", DISTANCE_FILE)

cells <- read_csv(CELL_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    ROI_ID    = if_else(is.na(ROI_ID) | ROI_ID %in% c("", "NA"),
                        ROI_WITHOUT_NUMBER, str_trim(ROI_ID)),
    RB_CD45   = str_squish(RB_CD45),
    RB_Immune = str_squish(RB_Immune),
    RB_PDL1   = str_squish(RB_PDL1),
    RB_Immune = recode(RB_Immune, !!!IMMUNE_RECODE, .default = RB_Immune)
  )

cat("Cells:", nrow(cells), "in", n_distinct(cells$ROI_ID), "ROIs\n")

unknown <- setdiff(na.omit(unique(cells$RB_Immune)), names(IMMUNE_COLOURS))
if (length(unknown)) warning("Immune label(s) without a colour: ",
                             paste(unknown, collapse = ", "))
```

## 2. Per-ROI percentages

```{r per-roi}
# Immune composition: % of cells in each population
immune_wide <- cells %>%
  filter(!is.na(RB_Immune), RB_Immune != "") %>%
  { if (EXCLUDE_NON_IMMUNE) filter(., RB_Immune != "Non_immune") else . } %>%
  count(ROI_ID, RB_Immune, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(ROI_ID) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ROI_ID, RB_Immune, percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = RB_Immune, values_from = percent,
              names_glue = "immune_{RB_Immune}", values_fill = 0)

# CD45+ fraction, as % of all cells; PD-L1, as % of the CD45+ cells, so that
# it shares a denominator with the cytokines below
fractions <- cells %>%
  group_by(ROI_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cells  = n(),
    total_CD45   = sum(RB_CD45 == "CD45+", na.rm = TRUE),
    CD45_percent = 100 * total_CD45 / total_cells,
    PDL1_percent = 100 * sum(RB_PDL1 == "CD45+PDL1+", na.rm = TRUE) /
                   pmax(total_CD45, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Cytokine positivity, as % of the CD45+ cells of the ROI
cytokines <- cells %>%
  filter(RB_CD45 == "CD45+") %>%
  group_by(ROI_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_CD45        = n(),
    IFNG_percent  = 100 * sum(Nuc_IFNG_dots  >= DOT_THRESHOLD, na.rm = TRUE) / n_CD45,
    CXCL9_percent = 100 * sum(Nuc_CXCL9_dots >= DOT_THRESHOLD, na.rm = TRUE) / n_CD45,
    IL1B_percent  = 100 * sum(Nuc_IL1B_dots  >= DOT_THRESHOLD, na.rm = TRUE) / n_CD45,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(-n_CD45)

per_roi <- fractions %>%
  left_join(immune_wide, by = "ROI_ID") %>%
  left_join(cytokines,   by = "ROI_ID")
```

## 3. Distance to the nearest nerve, and the 0–200 µm window

```{r distance}
distance <- read_csv(DISTANCE_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(ROI_ID = ROI) %>%
  mutate(ROI_ID = str_trim(ROI_ID),
         distance_um = as.numeric(Distance_nerve_um)) %>%
  select(ROI_ID, distance_um)

no_distance <- setdiff(per_roi$ROI_ID, distance$ROI_ID)
if (length(no_distance)) message("ROI(s) without a distance, not used: ",
                                 paste(no_distance, collapse = ", "))

per_roi <- per_roi %>% left_join(distance, by = "ROI_ID")
write_csv(per_roi, file.path(OUT_DIR, "per_ROI_values.csv"))

near <- per_roi %>% filter(!is.na(distance_um), distance_um <= MAX_DISTANCE_UM)

cat("ROIs within", MAX_DISTANCE_UM, "um of a nerve:", nrow(near),
    "of", sum(!is.na(per_roi$distance_um)), "\n")
```

## 4. Immune composition

```{r composition, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
immune_cols <- grep("^immune_", names(near), value = TRUE)

composition <- near %>%
  select(ROI_ID, all_of(immune_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ROI_ID, names_to = "population", values_to = "percent") %>%
  mutate(population = str_remove(population, "^immune_")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(percent))

# Order the populations by their median, most abundant first
pop_order <- composition %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  summarise(med = median(percent), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(med)) %>%
  pull(population)
composition$population <- factor(composition$population, levels = pop_order)

p_composition <- ggplot(composition, aes(population, percent)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = population), colour = "black", width = 0.55,
               outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = population), width = 0.15, size = 2.4, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = IMMUNE_COLOURS, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = IMMUNE_COLOURS, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = if (EXCLUDE_NON_IMMUNE) "% of immune cells per ROI"
           else "% of classified cells per ROI") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black"))

p_composition
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "Fig_immune_composition_0-200um.pdf"),
       p_composition, width = 6, height = 5)
```

## 5. Inflammatory milieu

```{r milieu, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
milieu <- near %>%
  select(ROI_ID, all_of(names(MARKERS))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ROI_ID, names_to = "marker", values_to = "percent") %>%
  filter(!is.na(percent)) %>%
  mutate(marker = factor(marker, levels = names(MARKERS), labels = MARKERS))

p_milieu <- ggplot(milieu, aes(marker, percent)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey85", colour = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% positive cells per ROI") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"))

p_milieu
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "Fig_inflammatory_milieu_0-200um.pdf"),
       p_milieu, width = 6, height = 5)
```

## 6. Summary table

```{r summary}
summarise_measure <- function(df, value_col, group_col, kind) {
  df %>%
    group_by(measure = .data[[group_col]]) %>%
    summarise(
      kind    = kind,
      n_ROIs  = n_distinct(ROI_ID),
      median  = round(median(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      IQR_low = round(quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      IQR_high = round(quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      mean    = round(mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      sd      = round(sd(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

summary_tbl <- bind_rows(
  summarise_measure(composition, "percent", "population", "immune population"),
  summarise_measure(milieu,      "percent", "marker",     "inflammatory marker"),
  tibble(measure = "CD45+ cells", kind = "fraction",
         n_ROIs  = nrow(near),
         median  = round(median(near$CD45_percent), 1),
         IQR_low = round(quantile(near$CD45_percent, 0.25), 1),
         IQR_high = round(quantile(near$CD45_percent, 0.75), 1),
         mean    = round(mean(near$CD45_percent), 1),
         sd      = round(sd(near$CD45_percent), 1))
) %>%
  relocate(kind)

write_csv(summary_tbl, file.path(OUT_DIR, "summary_0-200um.csv"))
knitr::kable(summary_tbl)
```

```{r legend, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
  paste0("\n**Figure legend.** Immune composition and inflammatory milieu in regions of ",
         "interest lying within %d um of a nerve (n = %d ROIs). Each dot is one ROI; ",
         "boxes show the median and interquartile range. Immune composition: percentage ",
         "of %s assigned to each population by the rule-based classifier. ",
         "IFN-gamma, CXCL9 and IL1B: percentage of CD45+ cells with at least %d nuclear ",
         "dots for that transcript. PD-L1: percentage of CD45+ cells classified as ",
         "CD45+PDL1+.\n"),
  MAX_DISTANCE_UM, nrow(near),
  if (EXCLUDE_NON_IMMUNE) "immune cells" else "classified cells",
  DOT_THRESHOLD))
```
